blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philex Mining Corp. said mining operations at its mine site in Tuba, Benguet, continue despite the ongoing workers’ strike over wages. “So far, mining and processing operations have continued and remained unhampered,” the Pangilinan-led mining company said in a disclosure on Monday.
